located_point.method: Wikidata starting point kept. It falls in fields 1.3 km north-east of Bhirrana village; the mound could not be distinguished from the village and fields around it in the Sentinel-2 composite, and no plan was available to locate it.

sources.result: No line measured. Fields surround the starting point; the village to the south-west, with a pond and bare ground on its east side, shows no straight feature that could be identified as Harappan without a plan.

notes: Not measurable. Held and downloaded sources checked for a plan of Harappan architecture: Indian Archaeology - A Review 2004-05 (PDF pp. 44-62; Fig. 3 on PDF p. 48 is the 'DWELLING PIT COMPLEX' plan, with a north arrow, showing circular pits of the earliest occupation in a trench grid and no straight Harappan architecture) and 2005-06 (PDF pp. 25-32, text and photographs); Puratattva 34 (2003-04), 'Unearthing Harappan Settlement at Bhirrana (2003-04)' (held scan puratattva36_retry.pdf, PDF pp. 32-34, text only); Puratattva 35 (2004-05), 'New Light on the Excavation of Harappan Settlement at Bhirrana' (held scan puratattva35_retry.pdf, PDF pp. 74-82, text and tables); Puratattva 36 (2005-06), 'Bhirrana Excavation - 2005-06' and 'The Harappan Spoked Wheels Rattled Down the Streets of Bhirrana' (downloaded IGNCA 88670, PDF pp. 59-81, text and wheel drawings).
unmeasurable_reason: No plan found: no held or openly available plan of Harappan straight architecture at Bhirrana with a north arrow (the only plan, IAR 2004-05 Fig. 3, shows pre-Harappan dwelling pits). Features not resolvable at 10 m: no straight Harappan feature can be identified in the imagery.
plan_search: No plan of Harappan architecture with a north arrow was found (21 October 2026). The 2025 'New light on the excavation at Bhirrana' PDF listed in optional-plan-search-v1.json returned HTTP 404.
